layers.container: runs inside the cbox docker image; Linux forever, never ported, excluded from the portability gates
layers.fixture-snapshot: a frozen historical snapshot read as fixture data by a parity test, never executed as a live script; excluded from every gate
layers.host: runs on the developer/operator machine; in scope for the bash-3.2/GNU-bashism portability gates
layers.template-generating-container-content: a script that runs on the host but whose job is to author or stage content that ends up inside the container (compose/dockerfile generation, MCP json rendering, hook staging); the script itself is host-layer and in scope for the gates, the content it emits is container-layer and out of scope
layers.test: lib/test_* host-side test harness; not part of the shipped host/container boundary but tracked so the inventory covers every script in the tree; in scope for the bash-3.2 parse gate (tests must also run on a 3.2 floor host) but not for the GNU/bashism denylist ratchet, which targets production host code only
